title: Roadside Tea Stop
description: A continuous five-clip cinematic anime story about one young adult rider taking his classic motorcycle on a countryside outing and stopping for tea at a roadside stall.

workflow_intake_contract.checked_in_content: Complete example prompt book; replace it after intake for every new run.
questions: Idea/Prompt: What should the video be about?
Duration: How long should the finished video be? Maximum 5 minutes.

duration_planner.balanced_duration_formula: base=floor(total_seconds/clip_count); first remainder clips use base+1 seconds; all remaining clips use base seconds
duration_planner.adjustable_pacing: The agent may increase clip_count for story pacing while every clip remains 3-10 seconds and all clip durations sum exactly to the requested duration.

workflow_intake_contract.generation_rule: After all three answers are received, rewrite this prompt book from the user's idea, calculate scene count and per-scene durations from the requested duration, and propagate the normalized ratio and duration plan through global settings, every image composition, VideoExpress generation, canvas, timeline, save, and export.

global_settings.visual_style: Cinematic 2D anime-style animated film with clean expressive linework, soft painterly backgrounds, natural character proportions, warm realistic lighting, detailed rural scenery, and smooth visual continuity.
global_settings.duration_plan_note: This checked-in example uses five equal 7-second story beats. New runs default to ceil(total/10) clips, but may use more shorter clips when pacing benefits.
continuity_rules: Use Actor 1's consistent-character portrait reference for every scene.

Keep Actor 1's face, age, hairstyle, skin tone, body proportions, mustard-yellow windbreaker, charcoal T-shirt, dark blue jeans, brown riding boots, and matte-black open-face helmet identical across all five clips.
Keep the same unbranded classic black bullet-style motorcycle with chrome fuel tank panels, round headlamp, tan leather saddle, twin rear shocks, and black exhaust in every scene.
Keep travel direction, late-afternoon sunlight, partly cloudy sky, rural road, surrounding green fields, and warm color palette continuous from clip to clip.

Scenes 2 through 5 must use the same small roadside tea stall: weathered timber frame, faded teal corrugated roof, clay-colored counter, steel kettle, glass tea cups, two wooden stools, and a large banyan tree behind it.
Keep faces clear and unobstructed during important expressions; use stable cinematic framing and simple readable actions.
Use clean unmarked frames, blank signboards, plain unbranded surfaces, and no readable writing, captions, watermarks, trademarks, or logos.
Synchronize motorcycle, road, wind, tea-stall, kettle, cup, and environmental sound effects with visible actions.

consistent_character.identity_lock: Always preserve Actor 1's softly angular oval face, medium warm-brown skin, dark brown eyes, thick brows, straight nose, short wavy black hair, clean-shaven jaw, slim athletic build, mustard-yellow windbreaker, charcoal T-shirt, dark blue jeans, brown boots, and matte-black open-face helmet.
